title: batchAccumulator operation
description: A passive holdup of choupoBatch: a vessel that only collects what the recipe transfers into it (a dosing tank, a receiver, a place the interlock parks a stopped feed). It has NO `operation` block; its starting state is the unit's `initial {}` block -- T and P required, V optional (default 0), and optionally `totalMoles` with a composition (empty by convention) (BatchAccumulator.cpp:36-50).
